metadata.description: Single source of truth for all Mermaid diagram styling and configuration

userLayer.name: Light Blue
userLayer.semantic: User Layer - User triggers, interactions, manual input points, user decisions

agentLayer.name: Light Purple
agentLayer.semantic: Agent Layer - Claude detects, executes, generates, AI reasoning and analysis tasks

automationStep.name: Light Yellow
automationStep.semantic: Automation Steps - Makefile dispatching, script execution, validation checks, system operations

stopNode.name: Light Red
stopNode.semantic: Stop Nodes - Error conditions, blocking states, user action required

successNode.name: Light Green
successNode.semantic: Success Nodes - Workflow completion, successful outcomes

blackBoxStep.name: Light Gray
blackBoxStep.semantic: Black Box Steps - Pre-commit hooks, external system interactions, simplified complex processes

entryPoint.name: Very Light Green
entryPoint.semantic: Entry Points - Workflow initiation points, chain entry from other workflows

subgraphs.template:
subgraph WorkflowBox["🤖 WORKFLOW NAME
📄 See: script-name.sh"] direction TB Content["Workflow content"] end
